name: Stollhofer
beschreibung:
Overview

The Gasthof zum Stollhofer is a family-run establishment in Inzing in the Tyrolean Inn Valley, near Innsbruck, operated as a hotel, restaurant and apartments. The accommodation at Salzstraße 6, 6401 Inzing, is run by the Markt family and maintains a traditional and family-friendly atmosphere. Tirol.de lists the house as a 3-star inn. Guests stay in cosy rooms furnished in Tyrolean style with wood, some of which have a balcony and bathtub; the range extends from single rooms to large four-bed or family rooms. The inclusive services listed by the establishment include the breakfast buffet, a free parking space, the Welcome Card from two nights onwards and Wi-Fi internet. Within the house, guests have access to various Stüberln (cosy parlours), a restaurant, a dining room, a bar and a garden restaurant.

History/Background

According to the establishment, the history of the house dates back to before the year 1770, when the Markt family took possession of it. Since then it has been continuously run as an inn, now in its fifth generation. A small house gradually grew into ever new rooms, parlours and bedrooms; father Josef Markt built and converted much of it with his own hands. Since 1995, Josef jun. has run the inn. The surroundings include Lake Gaisau, which was formerly a recreation area with swimming, fishing and boating and today lies within the Gaisau nature reserve; fish have been reintroduced there, and a cycling and walking path leads through it.

Getting there

The inn is located at Salzstraße 6, 6401 Inzing in the Inn Valley, not far from Innsbruck. The official website lists a free parking space at the house as an inclusive service, so arriving by car is possible. For sporty guests, the establishment mentions the Inntalradweg (Inn Valley Cycle Path), which leads through the holiday region. Guests staying two nights or more receive the Welcome Card, with which excursions in the region can be planned. The exact directions to the address as well as possible public transport connections should be requested directly from the establishment (phone +43 5238 88119).

Tips

As a genuine Tyrolean inn, the establishment serves the best of regional cuisine; with the “Bewusst Tirol” coin it commits to using products from surrounding regions or from Austria. Specialities include the “Tiroler Teller” and the “Beef Tartare”, which must not be missing from the menu. The breakfast buffet is open not only to guests staying at the house but also to visitors from outside; table reservations are possible according to the website on +43 5238 88119. Around Inzing, the mountains invite hiking and mountain biking in summer, while in winter the slopes invite skiing or the cross-country trails invite Nordic skiing.

Best time to travel

According to the establishment, the surroundings can be enjoyed all year round: in summer the surrounding mountains beckon for hiking and mountain biking, while in the cold season skiing and cross-country skiing take centre stage. For a visit to the restaurant, the opening hours stated on the website apply (Friday to Tuesday 18:00 to 20:30, on Sundays additionally 11:30 to 13:30); company holidays are listed on the website and should be checked before arrival.
